0.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_1
0.description: An adventurer on the trail of an elite mark, if I'm not mistaken. Go on and state your business, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>.

3.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Naul)

4.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Marraco)

5.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (Safat)

7.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_10
7.description: I hunt, I read, and one more thing─I help.

8.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_11
8.description: It's a simple life. If the hunt succeeds, I collect the bounty in Allied Seals. If I fail, well, there are always more books to read.

9.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_12
9.description: Now then, is there anything I can help you with? But of course there is─you adventurers are always getting in over your heads.

10.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_13
10.description: And speaking of “over your head,” never forget that marks are ranked according to danger. You'll not easily find a rank S mark, let alone bag one.

11.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_20
11.description: Ah, yes. You know how Ishgard is about dragons. The Holy See managed to get Naul and a few other dragons on to the elite mark list. A favor to be repaid in kind, I'm sure.

12.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_21
12.description: “The dragons Naul and Svara are best known for their attack on the Steel Vigil, which left the fortress a smoking ruin. Notable casualties include the third son of House Haillenarte...”

13.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_30
13.description: Every High House of Ishgard has its own dragon in a bonnet, don't they? An enemy without keeps order within. The dragon Marraco is to be hunted for the crime of mistaking almost a dozen of House Durendaire's knights for kindling.

14.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_31
14.description: “An impressive physical specimen by all accounts, the dragon Marraco can easily withstand a direct hit from dragonslayer cannons, thus requiring enterprising hunters to exercise some forethought in their choice of arms.”

15.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_40
15.description: “A winning combination of size and agility, the dragon Safat spends much of its time winging its way through the Sea of Clouds.

16.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_41
16.description: “A scream or two, however, never fails to bring Safat streaking down to its prey, attuned as the beast is to terror and misery.

17.name: TEXT_REGROCNOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF1_00198_MOBHUNTERR1F1_000_42
17.description: “Some hunters have been known to subject themselves to hair-raising experiences in order to bait the dragon. Results have been mixed.”
